run_orpo_full_training: run ORPO full training on a preference dataset with a specified model and output directory
run_orpo_lora_training: run ORPO training with LoRA PEFT fine-tuning using configurable rank and alpha parameters
resume_orpo_training: resume ORPO training from the last checkpoint in the output directory
run_orpo_evaluation: run ORPO training with an evaluation strategy that logs and saves eval metrics
push_orpo_model_to_hub: run ORPO training and push the saved model to the HuggingFace Hub
